label: Reference Pattern Library — filtered subset for consulting-pptx-skill's Production Integration v1
sourceNote: Trimmed copy of REFERENCE-PATTERN-LIBRARY-V0.1.2.json (an external, independently-developed Visual Planner / Reference Pattern Selector project), limited to the 3 families that project's own Selector Holdout rounds 2-3 scored 10/10 with zero wrong selections: matrix, hierarchy, roadmap-phaseband. Fields specific to that project's own golden-fixtures/renderer (groundedIn, revisionNote, referenceAssets, evidenceStatus, renderability, referenceLocator) are dropped — they describe evidence and renderability against THAT project's render.js, not this one. What's kept is the semantic ELIGIBILITY CONTRACT (useWhen/requiredSemanticRoles/relationshipsRequired/doNotUseWhen/etc) each pattern's own spec explicitly scopes as Pattern-Selector-owned, independent of which renderer ultimately draws it. See pipeline/scripts/pre_family_ir_to_slide_spec.mjs for how a selected pattern here maps onto this project's own SlideSpec templates (matrix_2x2/issue_tree/gantt).

patterns.name: Matrix Hero (Priority Matrix, rich)
patterns.useWhen: 2 genuinely authored axes (not just 4 box-shaped items) AND at least one quadrant carries more than a single-sentence description — priorityLabel + title + body [+ evidence] authored per quadrant, not merely a label.
requiredSemanticRoles: label or title per populated quadrant
relationshipsRequired: axis_membership (>=1 per quadrant group, covering 2 distinct axis elements for at least 3 of the 4 possible quadrant groupIds)
patterns.emphasisModel: 0 or 1 quadrant may carry element.emphasis=true (an authored flag, never inferred from which quadrant 'sounds' most important).
patterns.supportingBand: none — matrix's own quadrant structure already carries the 'so what' per zone.
doNotUseWhen: only 1 axis is authored, or axis words describe the SAME dimension twice
4 box-shaped items exist but no 2-axis judgment criteria are ever articulated anywhere in the content — use cards instead
quadrant content is a single plain sentence with no priorityLabel/body richness — use RP-MATRIX-PLAIN-01 instead

patterns.name: Priority Matrix (plain / badge tier)
patterns.useWhen: 2 genuinely authored axes, but each quadrant is a single descriptive sentence — no separate priorityLabel/title/body/evidence fields authored per quadrant.
requiredSemanticRoles: label per populated quadrant (the single sentence)
optionalSemanticRoles: a short priority badge per quadrant (最優先/高/中/低)
patterns.emphasisModel: same as RP-MATRIX-HERO-01 — 0 or 1 quadrant may carry an authored emphasis flag.
patterns.doNotUseWhen: same near-miss boundary as RP-MATRIX-HERO-01. If richer per-quadrant fields ARE authored, use RP-MATRIX-HERO-01 instead — variant choice is purely about which fields were authored, not a quality judgment.

patterns.name: Workstream Hierarchy
patterns.useWhen: an authored root node (a named top-level owner/committee) with >=2 child nodes explicitly reporting to it.
optionalSemanticRoles: bullets or body per child (role/responsibility list)
relationshipsRequired: contains (root -> each child, at least 2 edges)
patterns.densityRange: low to medium, depends on child count and per-child detail
patterns.emphasisModel: no structural emphasis mechanism for this family yet — emphasis should stay empty.
patterns.doNotUseWhen: content has only a shared section heading over a flat list, with NO authored root/ownership relationship at all — use cards instead.

patterns.name: PMI Roadmap (phase-banded)
patterns.useWhen: milestones are grouped under authored phase objects (each phase has its own title/description) AND at least one milestone carries an authored emphasis marker.
optionalSemanticRoles: a slide-level closing/outcomes group distinct from any single phase or milestone
patterns.densityRange: medium — roadmap-phaseband's richness comes from phase/milestone COUNT more than field count
patterns.emphasisModel: milestone-level authored flag — exactly 1 milestone is typically emphasized.
patterns.supportingBand: often present — a slide-level closing takeaways group distinct from any individual phase or milestone.
patterns.doNotUseWhen: milestones exist but are NOT grouped under authored phase objects (no contains edges) — use the plain 'roadmap' template's flat `sections` shape instead.

patterns.name: Executive KPI Dashboard
patterns.groundedIn: pipeline/reference-patterns/golden-fixtures-v0.2/RP-KPI-EXEC-DASHBOARD-01.jpg — Library v0.2, first pattern implemented (not part of the external Visual Planner project's own library; independently defined for this project).
patterns.useWhen: 3-5 KPIs, each with an authored label+value, numbers-as-the-main-content (not explanatory prose), and the slide's purpose is a summary/performance-snapshot/executive overview — not a single hero metric, not a dense 6+ metric table, and not primarily a time-series or item-comparison story.
requiredSemanticRoles: title (KPI label) + value (KPI number) per KPI, 3-5 KPIs
optionalSemanticRoles: body (driver/context note) and context (subtitle) per KPI
icon (bar-chart/coins/pie/cycle) and spark (comma-separated mini-history) per KPI
a slide-level headline (groupId=null) as the key-message band above the KPI row
an insights group (bullets, bordered panel) and/or a trendChart group (1-2 bar series + an optional line series on its own scale) below the KPI row
patterns.emphasisModel: no structural emphasis mechanism for this family — KPI values speak for themselves; don't author emphasis here.
patterns.supportingBand: optional — an insights list and/or a trend chart below the KPI row, distinct from any single KPI tile.
doNotUseWhen: only 1 KPI is authored — use a hero-KPI-shaped template instead
6+ KPIs are authored — this becomes a dense dashboard/table, not this pattern
explanatory prose is the main content and numbers are incidental — use cards instead
the point is a time-series comparison across many periods — use a chart template instead
the point is comparing named items/options against each other — use RP-COMPARISON-TABLE-01 instead
